svg.title: Three ways out of vm-client
svg.desc: From vm-client, pe-svc reaches vm-svc in the unpeered provider VNet through Private Link, and vm-svc sees pls-svc's NAT address, not the client's. The name …st.blob.core.windows.net resolves through the privatelink zone to pe-blob, so that account is reached through the private endpoint. …other has no private endpoint, resolves to a public address and goes through the subnet's Microsoft.Storage service endpoint, where sep-storage, which allows …st only, refuses it with 403.
